questions.question: What is the difference (in Rs.) between the compound interests on Rs. 4000 for 1 year at 12% per annum compounded yearly and half - yearly?
questions.solution:
Compound interest if it was compounded annually can be given as

⇒ CI = 4000{(1 + 12/100) - 1}

⇒ CI = 480

Compound interest if it was compounded half yearly can be given as

⇒ CI = 4000{(1 + 6/100)² - 1} = 4000{(1.06)² - 1}

⇒ CI = 4000 × 0.1236 = 494.4

So, difference = 494.4 - 480 = 14.4

questions.question: A can finish a work in 18 days and B in 36 days. If they work on it together for 9 days, then what percent of work is left?
questions.solution:
Work done by A in 1 day = 1/18th of total work

Work done by B in 1 day = 1/36th of total work

If the work together for 9 days, % of work left by them can be written as

⇒ [1 - 9 × {(1/18) + 1/36}] × 100

⇒ (1 - 1/2 - 1/4) × 100 = 100/4 = 25%

∴ The percentage of work left by them is 25%

questions.question: The sum of a fraction and 7 times its reciprocal is 11/2. What is the fraction?
questions.solution:
Let the fraction be y

According to the problem statement

⇒ y + 7/y = 11/2

⇒ 2y² + 14 - 11y = 0

⇒ (y - 7/2)(y - 2) = 0

the required fraction is 7/2 which satisfies the above given condition

∴ the value of required fraction is 7/2

questions.question: If on a Sale there is 30% discount on the marked price of Rs. 2500, but the sale is done at Rs. 1400 only. What additional discount (in %) did the customer get?
questions.solution:
Price after 30% discount can be given as

⇒ Price after 30 % discount = 2500 × (1 - 30/100) = Rs. 1750

But it was sold for Rs. 1400

additional discount = 1750 - 1400 = 350

Discount percentage can be given as

⇒ Discount percentage = 350 × 100/1750 = 20%

∴ The additional discount is 20%

questions.question: To travel 432 km, an Express train takes 1 hour more than Duronto. If however, the speed of the Express train is increased by 50%, it takes 2 hours less than Duronto. What is the speed (in km/hr) of Duronto train?
questions.solution:
Let the speed of Duronto train be y km/hr and that of Express train be z km/hr

According to the problem statement

⇒ 432/y + 1 = 432/z

⇒ 1/z = 1/y + 1/432 ----(i)

If speed of Express train increased by 50%, now the speed will be 1.5 z,

Now

⇒ 432/1.5z + 2 = 432/y Using (i)

⇒ 288(1/y + 1/432) + 2 = 432/y

⇒ 288/y + 2/3 + 2 = 432/y

⇒ y = 54 km/hr

∴ the speed of Duronto train is 54 km/hr

questions.question: If the profits are added to the company's reserves and the reserves stood at Rs 150 lakhs at the end of 2015, what were the reserves (in Rs. lakhs) in the beginning of 2012?
questions.solution:

questions.question: In a class of 50 students there are 27 boys. The average weight of these boys is 72 Kg and average weight of the full class is 55.44 kgs. What is the average weight (in kgs) of the girls of the class?
questions.solution:
Number of girls in the class can be given as 23 (i.e. 50 - 27)

Average weight of boys is 72

⇒ sum of weight of boys/27 = 72

⇒ sum of weight of boys = 27 × 72 = 1944 ----(i)

Average weight of all students is 55.44

⇒ (Sum of weight of boys + sum of weight of girls)/50 = 55.44

⇒ (Sum of weight of boys + sum of weight of girls) = 55.44 × 50 = 2772 Using (i)

⇒ sum of weight of girls = 2772 - 1944 = 828

Average weight of girls can be given as

⇒ average weight of girls = sum of weight of girls/23 = 828/23 = 36

∴ The average weight of girls is 36 kgs

questions.question: Pranita got 30 marks more in Math than what she got in Science. Her Math marks are 60% of the sum of her Math and Science marks. What are her Science marks?
questions.solution:
Let the marks in science be x

⇒ marks in maths = 30 + x

According to the problem statement

⇒ 30 + x = {60(x + x + 30)}/100

⇒ 30 + x = 1.2x + 18

⇒ x = 60

∴ the marks in science be 60

questions.question: What is the third proportional to 10 and 25?
questions.solution:
Given:

The numbers are 10 and 25

Formula used:

a : b :: c : d

⇒ a/b = c/d

Calculation:

Let the third proportional be x

⇒ 10/25 = 25/x

⇒ 10 = 625/x

∴ x = 625/10 = 62.5

∴ The third proportional of two numbers 10 and 25 is 62.5.

questions.question: Point A (2, 1) divides segment BC in the ratio 2 : 3. Co-ordinates of B are (1, -3) and C are (4, y). What is the value of y?
questions.solution:
Using the Properties of straight line

y coordinate of A = (2 × y + 3 × (- 3))/(2 + 3)

⇒ 1 = (2y - 9)/5

⇒ y = 7

∴ the value of y is 7

questions.question: If Sin θ = 20/29, then what is the value of Cos θ?
questions.solution:
Since we know that Cos θ = √(1 - sin² θ)

⇒ Cos θ = √(1 - 20²/29²)

⇒ Cos θ = √{(841 - 400)/29²}

⇒ Cos θ = √{(21²)/29²} = 21/29

∴ Cos θ = 21/29

The 3rd and 9th term of an arithmetic progression are - 8 and 10 respectively. What is the 16th term?
questions.solution:
Let the first term of AP be a and common difference be d

From the problem’s statement

⇒ 3rd term = a + (3 - 1)d = a + 2d = -8 ----(i)

⇒ 9th term = a + (9 - 1)d = a + 8d = 10 ----(ii)

Now (ii) - (i)

⇒ 6d = 18

⇒ d = 3, put this in (i)

⇒ a = -8 - 6 = - 14

Now the 16th term can be given as a + 15d

⇒ 16th term = - 14 + 15 × 3 = 31

∴ the 16th term of AP is 31

questions.question: ΔABC is right angled at B. BD is an altitude. AD = 9 cm and DC = 16 cm. What is the value of BD (in cm)?
questions.solution:
Let the ∠BCD = y

Now in triangle ABC and in BDC

⇒ cos y = BC/25 = 16/BC

⇒ BC² = 400

⇒ BC = 20

Now applying Pythagoras theorem in triangle BDC

⇒ BD = √(BC² - DC²)

⇒ BD = √(20² - 16²) = √144 = 12

∴ BD = 12 cm
